**Texere 0.4.18** · 13 November 2026

- **New versions install by themselves:** from this version on, when a new Texere is published, it installs in the background and starts when you reload Obsidian. You can turn this off in Settings → Texere → General → Install new versions by itself.

Also in this version (from 0.4.17, 0.4.16, 0.4.15): choose whether a Zotero reference comes with its PDF and annotations (closing the choice adds nothing); the pointer in PDFs selects without copying into the note; faster highlights; @ citations from Zotero without Better BibTeX; the bibliography right after the text.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page (this once), or BRAT at startup.
